title: Plurilock Files Information Circular and Schedules Shareholder Vote for C$33.8M ($24M USD) Acquisition by Quantum eMotion - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Cybersecurity solutions provider Plurilock Security Inc. (TSXV: PLUR) has officially filed its management information circular and scheduled a special shareholder meeting for November 18, 2026, to vote on its proposed acquisition by quantum entropy and post-quantum cryptography developer Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC; TSXV: QNC).

First announced in late September 2026, the court-approved plan of arrangement values Plurilock at approximately C$33.8 million (~$24 million USD), representing total consideration of C$0.28 per share—a 100% premium over Plurilock’s 20-day volume-weighted average price prior to announcement. Under the agreed terms, Plurilock shareholders will receive C$0.084 in cash (30%) and 0.0763 of a Quantum eMotion common share (70%) for each share held.

The transaction is designed to accelerate commercial adoption of Quantum eMotion’s quantum random number generators (QRNG) and FIPS 140-3/NIST 800-90B validated entropy technologies by embedding them into Plurilock’s established AI-driven identity, critical IT, and public-sector procurement channels across Canada, the U.S., and NATO alliance partners.

Plurilock’s Board of Directors unanimously recommends that shareholders vote in favor of the arrangement, which requires two-thirds majority approval at the November 18 meeting alongside customary court and stock exchange approvals.
